F21 Relationship to host platform

Host platform

F21.host-platform The platform this surface runs on.

● supported

Value: Grok Bot runs only on Cursor-hosted cloud computers, and the computers Bots work on run in Cursor's cloud. On-premises deployment, deployment inside your own perimeter, and bring-your-own-image deployment are not supported today.

Evidence:

  • E-grok-bot-00414

    Grok Bot runs only on Cursor-hosted cloud computers. On-premises deployment, deployment inside your own perimeter, and bring-your-own-image deployment are not supported today. Hosted computers use shared static egress by default. Members can route traffic through their desktop, and Enterprise teams

    Source: https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot/security.md; retrieved 2026-10-04; version not recorded; tier E1

  • E-grok-bot-00247

    The computers Bots work on run in Cursor's cloud.

    Source: https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot.md; retrieved 2026-10-04; version not recorded; tier E1

Shared account and billing

F21.shared-account-billing Whether account and billing are shared with a sibling.

● supported

Value: Grok Bot uses your Cursor account. There is no separate Grok Bot login. Access is included on every paid individual Cursor plan and on Cursor Teams, and usage can also be granted by linking an individual SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy, or X Premium+ subscription.

Evidence:

    Grok Bot uses your Cursor account. There is no separate Grok Bot login.

Shared execution infrastructure

F21.shared-execution-infrastructure Whether machines or VMs are shared with a sibling.

◐ partial

Value: All of a user's Bots use the same cloud computer, sharing its files, browser sessions, and app logins. Each user's work executes on a dedicated cloud computer in Cursor's cloud, and each team member gets one hosted computer where every Bot they run does its work.

Limitation: Quotes show one dedicated computer per user, shared across that user's Bots and hosted in Cursor's cloud. None states whether machines or VMs are shared with a sibling product.

◐ partial

Value: Bots work from a persistent cloud computer with a browser, command line and filesystem, and work continues while the laptop is closed. Reconnecting and Recover usually take a few minutes, and Continue in Background is offered.

Scheduled routines

Cloud agents

F15.cloud-agents Agents that run on the vendor's machines.

● supported

Value: Grok Bot is a computer-use agent that runs in Cursor's cloud, and each user's work executes on a dedicated cloud computer. Delegation to other agents

F15.delegation Handing work to another harness or agent product.

◐ partial

Deprecation policy

F20.deprecation-policy How removals and renames are announced.

◐ partial

Value: When Cursor stops supporting a build, the app covers its whole window with Update required until the member updates. A build loses support when it falls below Cursor's minimum version, or when it passes a maximum age and a newer release is available. Grok Bot requires an update when a version is more than 14 days old and a newer version is out.

Limitation: Cursor doesn't publish how long older installers stay available for download, and a pinned build works only until Cursor stops supporting it.

F22.budget-caps Spend or token limits a user or admin can set.

◐ partial

Value: An on-demand cap can be set in Grok Bot under Settings > On-demand monthly limit, or on the web at cursor.com/dashboard > Spending > Monthly Limit. Extra usage after Weekly usage runs out is billed through Cursor and counts toward the On-demand monthly limit.

Limitation: A separate Grok Bot spend cap is not available today. The cap does not stop a Bot in the middle of a run, so a running task can go a little past it.

Telemetry and OpenTelemetry

F22.telemetry-otel Metrics and traces the harness emits.

◐ partial

Value: OpenTelemetry Export streams Cursor usage metrics and logs, including recorded Grok Bot actions, to a collector you run, configured under Team Settings > OpenTelemetry Export. When configured, Action Recording events are sent to your collector tagged `cursor.surface=grok_bot`.

Limitation: OpenTelemetry Export is Enterprise only.
